provenance.hub_loads: ALL STATE CURRENTS ASSUMED. Pi-only allocations exclude separately listed USB load. USB1.2A aggregate provisional allocation requires official limit/revision confirmation. DAQ/storage placeholder draw is inside USB; wet camera terminal power is separate and calculated tether copper/contact loss at minimum battery voltage is added to the HUB input budget. No modem/gateway/lighting/heater/array/wiper/projector load included; these missing loads block final sizing.
provenance.reef_loads: Whole ESP DevKit and interface currents are assumed, not chip deep-sleep data. Dedicated3.3V radio converter candidate is unselected; do not draw it from DevKit3V3.120mA radio burst allocation exceeds vendor87mA operating point but is not a measured maximum. MPPT19mA at12V is vendor load-on data; BMS0.1W and converter efficiencies are assumptions.
provenance.inrush: Capacitance4700uF,10ms linear voltage ramp, simultaneous startup, no active limiter are assumptions. Converter input capacitance/inrush is absent from retrieved datasheet. Capacitor ramp current is not an actual hot-plug peak bound.
